description: The `if (!tracker.isCurrent(id)) return;` guard is removed, so every response is rendered in arrival order. Debounce and loading state are intact. Typing "an" (700ms) then "ann" (100ms) first renders the 2 "ann" rows, then the stale "an" response overwrites them with 7 rows; the critical stale-response-ignored test waits 900ms after seeing 2 rows and observes 7 (and "andy"), so it fails. clear-input, empty-state and loading tests still pass.
